### 2026-10-08 – Trace her? But I hardly know her!

**3h**

Trace her? But I hardly know her!
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/6695ecbccd2cb9b978e4ef324c5111793def2f9a75bf38843799dcbe2585817a.png)
^^The pcb without the edges is around 61mm x 51mm
Today I wanted to do all of the traces, but I severely underestimated the time requirements of doing so. When I started I thought that this task would take about an hour or so, and thus I was not expecting to dump 3 hours into it. To be fair I am just learning though, although I hope I do get faster...
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/004f74dc492e47aa6425530266a8bbc97da9ea9f43eb900404c7e03c26decce5.png)
I am yet to put the big ground and +3v3 copper areas (IDK what they are called) down, but otherwise I think the board is looking really nice. I am really proud of how compact I made it, at the cost of hours of my day. In the future I would almost certainly go with the already made pico 2, but making this was a vital experience in terms of how those boards actually work.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/1f9f5089a48166713c43e4dce862b75c4453ae6b281e46be591216606a62342a.png)
Understandably, DRC is throwing a hissy fit, although most, if not all, of those errors will be resolved by putting in the area thingies (still don't know what they are called).
TLDR: Did 90% of the PCB, and severely underestimated time costs...
